critical_code_review_comments: auth.py reset_password: users.update_one uses row['_id'] to mark used=true — works but couples to Mongo primary key; using token_hash filter would be equivalent and consistent with the read path. Non-blocking.

auth.py forgot_password: rate limit is per-user (RESET_MAX_PER_HOUR=3) but NOT per-IP or per-email — a malicious actor probing many known emails is not throttled globally. Consider a per-IP hourly cap too. Non-blocking / hardening.

auth.py forgot_password: send_email() can raise HTTPException(502) from emailer.py if Emergent proxy fails, breaking the 'always generic' contract by leaking a 502 to the client. Consider wrapping send_email in try/except and still returning the generic 200 so timing/errors can't be used to enumerate accounts. Recommended fix.

auth.py reset_password: on success, all previous unused tokens for the same user are NOT invalidated — a stolen prior token (still within TTL) remains usable until it expires or is used. Consider invalidating siblings ({user_id, used:false} → used:true) after success.
ResetPassword.jsx: on backend failure the error is set from err.response?.data?.detail — works, but pending state stays cleared (good). No accessibility label on password inputs (aria-label). Minor.
